thread:
alice (AE): SymphonyCare POC kickoff. Req: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (delta), group->role mapping, tenant slicing by subdomain with DNS TXT proof. BYOK flagged as potential later need. Can we align 3pm PT today? Need answers before Friday.

ben (SE): 3pm works. Quick Qs: SP-init vs IdP-init both needed? Also what NameID format do they expect (email vs persistent)?

claire (Security): High-level: signed assertions required, assertion encryption optional. ACS endpoints must enforce HTTPS + HSTS. Audit logs for auth/provisioning retained 24 months. BYOK/HSM will probably force Private deployment — mark as blocker. SCIM must support delta + documented retry/backoff and rate limits. Need proof of tenant via DNS TXT.

dave (Solutions): SCIM mapping example to share with their IdP admin: {"userName":"emails[0].value","displayName":"name.formatted","groups":"groups","tenant":"urn:redwood:tenant"}  — send this to Okta/Azure admin.

ben (SE): Hosted enterprise supports delta SCIM for POC and we can temporarily lift rate limits for import. Bulk guaranteed windows and SLA-backed provisioning are Dedicated features. I'll prepare a short SAML metadata sample and troubleshooting checklist (clock skew, cert thumbprint, assertion viewer).

alice (AE): Action items: 1) @ben share SAML metadata + troubleshooting 2) @dave send SCIM mapping to customer 3) @claire mark which questionnaire answers require Private 4) I'll schedule 3pm and include their IdP admin.

infra-bot: Reminder: demo-provisioner cluster will be auto-terminated in 72h unless extended (request via #eng-infra).

alice (AE): Thanks — see you at 3pm. I'll attach the security questionnaire to the invite. :white_check_mark:
